caption: Three taxis each way is R2 700 a month for me. What does your commute cost?

slides.title:
What getting to work
costs me on
R14 900 p/m
Living in Mabopane
slides.body:
Female, 31
Single, one son (6) stays with her mother
Job: Admin clerk, government department in Pretoria
Net salary: R14 900 p/m

slides.title: Commute
slides.includes: Taxi to the rank, train when it runs, second taxi in town
slides.body: Three legs each way. When the train is cancelled the day costs R40 more.

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Room and bathroom in a yard
slides.body: It's close to my sister, who fetches my son from school.

slides.title: Support for my mom & son
slides.includes: Son's school fees, aftercare, my mom's groceries
slides.body: My son stays with her during the week because the commute would eat his childhood.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: For me and the weekends my son comes
slides.body: Weekend food is more expensive because I overcompensate.

slides.title: Lunch & snacks at work
slides.includes: Vetkoek, a cooldrink, chips, the Friday kota
slides.body: R50 a day looks like nothing. It's the number I'm least proud of.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Airtime, funeral policy, stokvel, electricity top-ups, clothes account, hair
slides.body: The stokvel is R400 and the clothes account is R600 I'm still paying off.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R14 900. Transport and lunch together are a quarter of what I earn, just to be at a desk.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and it grouped every taxi and train payment into one transport total.

I had been guessing R1 500.

No bank login needed.
